_meta.scope: Simulation / code / bookkeeping checks of the current detection code and a text inventory of tracking components. Synthetic signals only; no comparison against RF measurements.

definitions.pd: gpu_montecarlo hit rate: CFAR-masked global maximum within +-2 cells of the noiseless truth cell.
definitions.pfa_emp: gpu_montecarlo target-free false detections divided by cells outside the zero-Doppler +-2 rows.
definitions.physical_combiner_loss_db: 10log10(|w^H a|^2/(|w|^2|a|^2)), w = ULA steering at the wrong azimuth, a = ULA response at the true azimuth; relative to ideal steering.
definitions.snr50_n1_minus_n4_db: curves['1'].snr50 - curves['4'].snr50 per mode in outputs/detection_rx_sweep.json.
definitions.ideal_gain_db: 10log10(4), coherent gain of 4 elements with independent noise.
definitions.extra_lag_samples: argmax|fftconvolve(impulse, channel_taps kernel)[:L]| - impulse index - requested delay.
definitions.axis_shift_m_when_meta_rb_changes: max |Rb_axis(meta Rb B) - Rb_axis(meta Rb A)| for the same IQ.
definitions.retained_db_measured: 10log10(sum|ECA(s)|^2 / sum|s|^2) for a noiseless delayed echo with nu Doppler bins.
definitions.retained_db_analytic: 10log10(1 - |mean_n exp(j2pi nu n/N)|^2); null when the argument is 0 (nu = 0).
definitions.doppler_bin: cycles of Doppler phase over the whole CPI (= Doppler FFT bins).
definitions.false_cells: CFAR detections in rows farther than 2 rows from the strong cell's row.
definitions.float32_input_float64_sum: cfar_batch on the float32 map cast to float64 before squaring and summing.
definitions.max_cell_over_median_db: 10log10(max cell power / median cell power) of the float32 L1 map.
definitions.mask_mismatches: number of cells where float32 and float64 cfar_batch masks differ (summed over n_rx rows).
definitions.f14_loss_db: 20log10(|production map at truth cell| / |per-frame-reference map at truth cell|).
definitions.repeated_frame_control_db: Same ratio when all frames repeat frame 0 (the case every tiled builder is in).
definitions.hits_in_src_benchmark: number of matching lines in *.py under src/ and benchmark/ excluding *isac*0915*.
definitions.hits_in_files_mentioning_cfar: subset of those hits in files that contain 'cfar' anywhere.
definitions.cfar_connected_components_8conn: scipy.ndimage.label of the CFAR mask with a 3x3 structuring element.
definitions.loss_plus_ten_log10_ML_db: f14 loss_db + 10log10(M*L); near 0 when the loss equals the full coherent gain.
definitions.production_peak_to_median_db: 20log10(max / median) of the production magnitude map in the f14 probe.
definitions.peak_at_truth: ours() Doppler-guarded argmax equals (zero-Doppler row + dopp_bin_true, r_bin_true).
definitions.component_id: comma-free row identifier for condition selectors.
definitions.hits_spec_terms_only: matching lines for spec_grep_pattern (spec terms only), same file set.
definitions.implementation_defs: function/class definitions (AST) whose name matches spec_grep_pattern.
definitions.library_calls_or_imports: AST call nodes whose function name (or base.name) is in library_call_names, plus import statements of library_modules or of those names.
definitions.library_calls_or_imports_in_functions_ca: subset whose innermost enclosing function (or the module body) also calls a function whose name contains 'cfar'.
definitions.library_calls_or_imports_in_files_callin: subset in files with any call to a name containing 'cfar'.
definitions.implementation_defs_or_library_calls_in_: implementation_defs in files calling a cfar function plus library_calls_or_imports_in_files_calling_cfar; 0 means no named definition or listed library call of that component sits in a file on the CFAR detection path.
definitions.dB_ratio_sign: physical_combiner_loss_db and f14 loss_db are 10log10 / 20log10 ratios and are negative when power is lost; do not add a second minus sign when writing 'loss'.
definitions.mask_mismatches_at_production_pfa: mask_mismatches with pfa = the L1 production pfa_nominal.

assumptions.text: Findings 1-2 use an analytic integer-delay echo on a tiled QPSK frame, not a Sionna kernel echo or a report12 waveform.
Precomputed adds the module DPI_AMP direct-path term (value recorded in f4_cfar.report12_l1_check.dpi_amplitude; env SIONNA2_DPI_AMP unset=True).

report12 L1 check uses analytic_echo instead of the Sionna kernel echo, geometry X410Scenario defaults, velocity and the echo amplitude scale read from outputs/detection_rx_sweep.json meta (the velocity key and the analytic point-echo amplitude scale key), one noise draw, n_rx 1 and 4, CFAR pfa from CONFIG f4 and, separately, the production pfa_nominal of the L1 mode.
Radial speed per Doppler bin uses the monostatic-equivalent v = f_d * wavelength / 2; bistatic Doppler depends on geometry.

ECA low-Doppler rows use a short synthetic frame (Lf in f3_eca.sizes) instead of the production frames (f3_eca.production_frame_rows, read from outputs/detection_rx_sweep.json); taps and ridge are the production values (N_TAPS and ridge_rel read from code).
Float32 CFAR rows use a 64x32 unit-mean background with one strong cell; real maps with extended ridges were not modelled.

Tracking inventory is a regex/AST text scan; a grep hit is a mention, not an implementation, and a miss outside src/ and benchmark/ is not asserted. grep_pattern is wider than the spec term list (spelling variants and near terms such as aoa, bare gating, ndimage.label, track initiation, mota); spec_grep_pattern holds the spec terms only. Library call names and modules per row are a chosen list, not an exhaustive one.

_meta.source_hashes_note: source_hashes lists files whose content a value depends on (quoted, executed or read ledgers); the full inventory scan is covered by tracking_inventory.scanned_files_digest_sha256.

f14_reference.note: Every CPI builder quoted in tile_quotes repeats one reference frame M times, which is the repeated-frame control of the rows (0 dB). The AST scan of range_doppler/rd_batch/make_cpi callers finds tile evidence in every calling file except those listed in kernel_callers_not_classified_as_tiled. The exception, benchmark/verify_pyapril.py, builds a non-repeating QPSK reference; its ours() chain is not called by main() and its ledger does not store that chain's result, so no published output depends on it. Rerunning ours() on that scenario and on the same scenario with a repeated frame is in non_tiled_reference_case. The scan looks for tile evidence per file, not for data flow.
